children.text: The Gacha page stays a shop front; ROLL opens this roll window on top (the page is hidden behind it), then the reveal card. Tap = skip to the reveal. Higher rarity = longer build-up. Same reveal card for every option.
children.name: Sub

children.text: Mystery orb charges on an altar, colour tease, burst. Simple and dramatic; works for x1 and x10 (best of 10).
children.name: Desc

children.text: ROLL dims the shop and drops a mystery orb onto the altar.
children.name: Desc

children.text: Rings pulse; their colour climbs white -> lilac -> gold toward the real rarity (the tease).
children.name: Desc
